title: The League Pro
subtitle: Multi-User ESPN Fantasy Manager • 60/40 Moneyball + War Room
description: Full-PPR 2-FLEX Command Center with dynamic per-user Team Selection (all 12 Weekend Warriors teams or custom ESPN League ID), Personal Rockstar Lock, Multi-Horizon Opponent War Room, and Isolated User Watchlist.
tagline: Multi-User 12-Team ESPN Fantasy Football Command Center (`Weekend Warriors #945552`) • Moneyball + War Room

quickstart.step: Bind Your Personal Team (`⚙️ Switch Team`)
quickstart.detail: Tap `⚙️ Switch Team` in the top system strip to pick any of the 12 Weekend Warriors franchises. Your selection is saved privately to your Google account profile without affecting any other league-mate.

quickstart.step: Dial In Your Moneyball vs. Consensus Blend
quickstart.detail: Use the interactive Blend Slider (default `60% Moneyball / 40% Expert Consensus`) on your Roster tab to rank starters, flex options, and waiver targets using usage-weighted expected fantasy points.

quickstart.step: Lock Your Protected Core (`⭐`) & Test Sandbox Swaps
quickstart.detail: Tap the star/lock toggle on untouchable studs so waiver/drop recommendations never suggest cutting your core players, and test lineup swaps safely in your isolated Sandbox.

quickstart.step: Track Live Matchups & NFL Game Center
quickstart.detail: Open the Matchup tab or tap any game pill in the docked NFL Scoreboard ribbon at the bottom to inspect live play-by-play scoring, win probability swings, and active fantasy starters.

navigation_map.purpose: Optimal 1-QB / 2-RB / 2-WR / 1-TE / 2-FLEX / D-ST lineup solver (No-Kicker format), Blend Slider, and Protected Core locks.
Head-to-head real-time ESPN scoring, starter-vs-starter positional comparison, and live win projection.
Multi-week opponent vulnerability scanner—identifies upcoming opponents' positional holes to execute defensive waiver blocks.
Filtered free-agent targets ranked by Blended ROS/Weekly value, injury replacement urgency, and your private starred Watchlist.
League power rankings, player injury news feed, private player scouting notes, and live NFL Game Center boxscores.

deep_dive_features.title: 60/40 Moneyball Blend Engine (Full-PPR, 2-FLEX, No Kicker)
deep_dive_features.body: Combines target share, snap share, red-zone opportunity, and Vegas implied team totals (Moneyball) with consensus projections. Sliding toward 100% Moneyball favors volume breakouts before consensus catches up.

deep_dive_features.title: Multi-Horizon Opponent Counter-Pick War Room
deep_dive_features.body: Scans your current and upcoming opponents' bye weeks and injury designations, flagging high-leverage waiver claims that simultaneously upgrade your bench and block your opponent's weakest starter.

deep_dive_features.title: 100% Isolated Multi-User Profiles
deep_dive_features.body: Every signed-in user gets an isolated `RollupBridge.storage` bucket for their chosen Team ID, Protected Core locks, Watchlist stars, Sandbox roster moves, and private player scouting notes.

pro_tips: Check the War Room every Tuesday night before waivers process to spot opponents missing a QB/TE due to bye weeks.
Tap any player row to open the Player Dossier modal and jot down private scouting notes saved strictly to your device profile.
